interiorcatalogextension.description_text:
A furniture paradise for your CAD needs!

Regardless of which Ashampoo CAD you have, the Interior Catalog Extension takes interior design to a new level! 500 3D objects are waiting to be utilized, helping you make your projects more flexible, more attractive and as realistic as possible! Treat your CAD to a virtual furniture store!

Full-fledged interior design!

The Ashampoo Interior Catalog Extension provides more options for your individual room designs. Shelves, sideboards, highboards, lowboards, mostly as series with different sizes and layouts, bring your project to life and can be combined at your convenience. For consistency, wardrobes, tables, beds, floor lamps and other furnishings are also included.

Great visuals, mild resource requirements

The elements have a low polygon count. This allows for good visual quality without cluttering projects with unnecessary details and overloading the system. It also means you can use them in large numbers without performance hits. Different sizes and layouts offer numerous combinations for versatile room setups.

Fine-tune the details

All objects were created using the modeling functions built into each Ashampoo CAD edition and remain fully customizable. There are also individual components such as table legs that you can install yourself. Do you want to tweak the living experience in detail through other textures or materials from the standard catalog? Our Ashampoo CAD programs combined with Ashampoo Interior Catalog Extension make it possible!

interiorcatalogextension2.description_text:
Over 380 new 3D objects for realistic interior design

The Ashampoo Interior Collection 2 Extension expands your CAD or Home Design software with an extensive selection of high-quality furnishing elements. More than 380 detailed 3D objects allow you to design and present modern living spaces with impressive realism—from cozy living rooms to fully furnished bedrooms.

Wide selection of sofas, beds, and seating furniture

At the heart of the collection are around 160 sofas, including 2- and 3-seaters, L-shaped and U-shaped designs, as well as complete sofa series for cohesive interior concepts. The selection is complemented by approximately 46 beds, ranging from classic double beds and single beds to children’s beds. Around 90 armchairs and chairs—including bar stools, office chairs, dining chairs, recliners, and corner benches—provide maximum flexibility for living and working areas.

Decorative elements and rustic highlights for unique accents

The collection also includes about 70 additional interior objects such as wood-burning stoves, rugs, lamps, and curtains. A selection of rustic furniture pieces—including desks, cabinets, display cabinets, and armchairs—adds distinctive character and opens up new possibilities for traditional or country-style designs.

AI-generated and fully optimized for CAD performance

Most 3D objects were created using the latest AI technologies and then carefully optimized for use in Ashampoo CAD and Home Design software. Polygon counts were reduced to a performance-friendly level, materials were refined, and suitable 2D representations for floor plans were pre-calculated. This ensures realistic visuals while maintaining smooth and efficient performance during planning and presentation.

Seamless integration into your software

The Interior Collection 2 Extension is an add-on and requires an installed version of Ashampoo CAD or Home Design software. It is not a standalone product. The installer automatically copies all included files into the standard 3D object catalog, making them immediately available for both new and existing projects.

kitchencatalogextension.description_text:
The heart of a home is the kitchen!

It is the center and central living space of an apartment or a house. It is also a meeting point for family and friends. In a kitchen people eat, work, talk, play, laugh – and, of course, also cook.

In a building or modernization process special attention must be paid to the kitchen, because of its central function. The earlier and more exact the planning for the kitchen, the better. Planning mistakes in a kitchen concept can later hardly be altered without a great deal of construction work, which can also cost a lot of money.

A good kitchen is always a large investment and will be part of your home for quite a while. The appropriate layout of kitchen appliances like for example cooker, sink, refrigerator etc. is vital for an optimized kitchen plan.

Well planned, money saved!

The new Ashampoo Kitchen Catalog Extension enables you to plan your kitchen individually on your PC. The catalogue offers several 3D kitchen lines in different styles, from modern via simple through to elegant. Each kitchen line offers a large number of different objects and textures. This way you can exactly plan your dream kitchen.

Equip your kitchen with high-quality appliances on the highest standard. There is a large number of different appliances available to choose from. Furthermore the catalogue also contains objects like fittings to complete your project.

New kitchen? Plan it yourself on your PC!

The Ashampoo Kitchen Catalog Extension includes seven kitchen lines in different designs. Each kitchen line contains a complete set of kitchen furniture with wall and floor units as well as different cupboards etc.

Plan your dream kitchen in 3D and choose your furnishing from over 1,200 objects in every kitchen line.

ashampoohomedesign11.description_text:
Design, expand, and furnish with this 3D home planning tool

Find out how easy and innovative home design can be with Ashampoo Home Design. Import and edit millions of 3D objects in formats such as SketchUp and Collada and make your visions a reality. Plan roof-mounted photovoltaic systems with intuitive assistants and virtually design rooms with a wide selection of furniture and decorations. Ashampoo Home Design takes the complicated math off your shoulders, so you can fully concentrate on the design. Explore your projects in a realistic 3D preview and use the user-friendly multi-function bar for efficient and precise results. Ashampoo Home Design is the reliable partner for all your home planning needs!

Millions of ready-to-use objects for perfect furnishing results

Ashampoo Home Design supports loading, editing and saving of various new 3D object formats. This gives you access to millions of 3D objects! Simply import them and add them to your designs! With support for SketchUp or Collada models, you can now instantly use numerous generic and brand-specific models.

Plan photovoltaic installations with ease!

Comfortable input aids help you plan sophisticated photovoltaic systems in minutes. For roof-mounted systems, you can already specify their layout, select modules from the object catalog and their placement during the setup phase. The program will automatically determine the settings for the roof as soon as you point at the target side. Once configured, the photovoltaic installation will be added to your plan.

ashampoo3dcadarchitecture14.description_text:
Design your home virtually

Want to plan your home in peace and comfort on your PC? Ashampoo 3D CAD Architecture is the user-friendly design software for anyone ready to turn their vision into reality! The step-by-step wizard delivers quick and easy results, even for beginners. With 2D, 3D, and cross-section views, you always know exactly where your project stands and can instantly spot what’s missing and where changes are still needed—perfect for identifying weaknesses and avoiding design bottlenecks. New: A powerful electrical planning assistant helps place outlets, switches, and lighting fixtures quickly and accurately. Whether building from scratch, renovating, or just redecorating, find out what your future space will look like today. Get the 3D home planner that truly moves your project forward!

Powerful electrical planning assistant included!

Electrical planning has never been easier: With the new assistant, you can place outlets, switches, and lights exactly where you need them–with just a few clicks. Choose from predefined room types and equipment configurations or create your own templates. The assistant automatically analyzes your rooms and suggests optimal placements–saving you time and helping you avoid mistakes. Whether you're a beginner or a pro, this feature makes electrical planning faster, easier, and more intuitive!

Customization and full control over electrical symbols

In addition to the built-in symbols, you can add and manage your own electrical symbols. Use custom directories to directly integrate personalized elements into your plans. The assistant automatically creates a dedicated layer for electrical symbols, so you can show or hide the entire electrical installation with a single click. You can also manually move, rotate, and adjust all symbols–for maximum flexibility and precision! The assistant even auto-enhances your planning with a parts list of all electrical components used in your project.

New doors and sliding doors–enhancing design flexibility for more realistic drafts

New door models give you even more creative options. Innovative extra: Doors with asymmetrical wall openings. Now you can realistically depict sliding doors with track systems and without awkward overlaps. This added flexibility lets you design your floor plans even more accurately and individually, perfect for modern open concepts and advanced architectural projects!

New feature highlights

  • Hidden line optimization in elevation views
  • Fire Escape Plan plugin
  • Wizard for scale, frame placement, and plan layout
  • Comprehensive 2D symbol catalog with automatic legends
  • Exporting a List of 2D Symbols (PDF, RTF, Excel)
  • More than 280 new, freely scalable 3D objects
  • Extended PV objects including current solar modules and balcony power systems

Photovoltaic installations - rooftop arrays and flat roofs

No good project design should be without photovoltaic installations. For roof-mounted system, you can already specify their layout, select modules from the object catalog and their placement during the setup phase. For flat roofs, you can simply specify which parts will be or will not be used for photovoltaic elements during the design phase. When you're done, you can place the entire installation in just two clicks and adjust distances between rows of panels or rotate and realign them - it's the perfect approach to preliminary planning!

ashampoo3dcadprofessional14.description_text:
IFC-compatible, precise in detail, and reliable in data exchange

Ashampoo 3D CAD Professional 14 is a comprehensive 3D CAD solution for professional architectural and construction planning. From detailed floor plans and sections to fully developed 3D building models, the software supports the complete design process with precision and technical reliability. Advanced construction tools, structured project management, and extensive object catalogs enable efficient planning of residential, commercial, and public building projects. With integrated IFC-2x3 export, optimized elevation views, and powerful tools for creating fire escape plans, Professional 14 goes beyond pure design—providing a CAD environment built for modern BIM workflows and demanding project requirements.

Powerful electrical planning assistant included!

Electrical planning has never been easier: With the new assistant, you can place outlets, switches, and lights exactly where you need them–with just a few clicks. Choose from predefined room types and equipment configurations or create your own templates. The assistant automatically analyzes your rooms and suggests optimal placements–saving you time and helping you avoid mistakes. Whether you're a beginner or a pro, this feature makes electrical planning faster, easier, and more intuitive!

Customization and full control over electrical symbols

In addition to the built-in symbols, you can add and manage your own electrical symbols. Use custom directories to directly integrate personalized elements into your plans. The assistant automatically creates a dedicated layer for electrical symbols, so you can show or hide the entire electrical installation with a single click. You can also manually move, rotate, and adjust all symbols–for maximum flexibility and precision! The assistant even auto-enhances your planning with a parts list of all electrical components used in your project.

New doors and sliding doors–enhancing design flexibility for more realistic drafts

New door models give you even more creative options. Innovative extra: Doors with asymmetrical wall openings. Now you can realistically depict sliding doors with track systems and without awkward overlaps. This added flexibility lets you design your floor plans even more accurately and individually, perfect for modern open concepts and advanced architectural projects!

New feature highlights

  • Plan Layout with multiple views on a single sheet
  • Scaled plan layouts with PDF output
  • 2D drawing functions for adding drawing details and enhancing floor plans
  • Insert scanned floor plans (JPG, PNG) as images and use them as a blueprint to trace your 3D building model
  • Extended 2D drawing functions with custom line types and hatching
  • Create and edit custom 2D symbols
  • Combinable roof extensions and roof openings
  • Extended roof variants including hall roofs
  • Integrated 3D Converter with material and texture editing

Standards-compliant fire escape plans directly from the project

With the integrated Fire Escape Plan Plugin, standards-compliant safety plans can be created directly based on existing floor plans. A wizard assists with scale, drawing frame placement, and layout, while a comprehensive 2D symbol catalog and automatic legend generation streamline implementation. In addition, a structured export of all used 2D symbols is available—ideal for documentation and coordination. Professional 14 significantly expands its application scope for commercial and public construction projects.

IFC export for professional BIM workflows

With the integrated IFC-2x3 Export PlugIn, Ashampoo 3D CAD Professional 14 becomes fully BIM-compatible. Complete 3D building models can be exported, including structural elements such as walls, ceilings, floors, and roof structures, as well as finishing elements like windows, doors, and stairs. 3D catalog objects and custom 3D constructions are also reliably transferred. This allows planning data to be integrated into architectural, structural engineering, or cost-estimating software, enabling efficient collaboration within connected project environments. Professional here means full control over data and future-proof standards.

Powerful design an construction tools

Numerical input tools are the ultimate solution for precise planning, which is why the program heavily emphasizes this aspect! Dedicated input modes for walls, windows, and doors make your work incredibly easy, while numerical editing tools for the same areas add more precision and flexibility to your projects. Together with custom components for windows and doors, roller shutter boxes, blinds and borders, the design and construction section is a genuine highlight of the software!

 

Extensive object catalogs

Ashampoo® 3D CAD Professional is popular also because of the vast number of included 3D objects. Select from a variety of suitable 3D objects and over 250 ready-to-use object groups in the object catalog! The catalog includes groups full of pre-designed garages, kitchen lines, garden houses, and saunas, among others. Create your own catalog directories and use them directly in the catalogs, it couldn't be more convenient! Look forward to a program that sets hardly any limits for you and your projects!

Less is more?

Great, then our Ashampoo® 3D CAD Architecture is what you want! You don't need to import/export of 2D DXF/DWG files or export Maxon Cinema 4D files, and you don't want to construct windows yourself? But you still want a comprehensive, fully-fledged CAD application? Then the more affordable Ashampoo® 3D CAD Architecture is the ideal solution for you! After all, why should you pay for high-level professional features you won't be using anyway? Check out the comparison matrix and find the solution that is right for you!

buildingchickencoopsfordummies.description_text: Building Chicken Coops For Dummies teaches readers the basic construction skills they need to design and build their own coops. Materials lists, instructions, and schematic plans for building a host of different chicken coops are all included in this comprehensive guide.

electriccarsfordummies.description_text:
Charge into the future in your electric car

Tired of paying higher gas prices or for regular maintenance on a gas-powered car? An electric vehicle may be the answer to your needs! Electric cars are gaining popularity as car prices come down, gas prices go up, and the need to reduce emissions becomes greater. This book is your fun and easy guide to the steps in buying and owning an electric car. From calculating total cost of ownership of an electric car vs a gas-powered vehicle to prepping your living space for an electric car's charging needs, this book demystifies electric car ownerships and answers all your electric car questions, even those you haven't thought to ask yet!

Inside...

  • Explore electric car options

  • Discover how and when to charge your vehicle

  • Build a standard maintenance schedule

raisingchickensfordummies2ndedition.description_text:
Your hands-on guide to modern chicken-raising methods

Thinking about raising chickens? You've come to the right place! This new edition of Raising Chickens For Dummies provides the most up-to-date, thorough information on the many aspects of keeping chickens in your backyard. Inside, you'll find hands-on, easy-to-follow instructions on choosing and purchasing chickens, constructing housing for your birds, feeding your chickens for optimal health, combating laying issues, controlling pests and predators, optimizing egg production, and much more.

Raising chickens on a small scale is a popular—and growing—pastime. If you're interested in keeping chickens as pets or as a source for eggs, Raising Chickens For Dummies gives you plain-English explanations of everything you need to know to about caring for chickens. Inside, you'll learn about basic chicken biology, breeds, and behavior, which chicken breed is best for you, how many you need, ways to spot healthy chickens, how to build a chicken coop, best practices for mating your chickens, how to incubate eggs, how to hatch and nurture chicks, manage laying hens, collect and store eggs, and butcher meat birds.

  • Offers practical advice on choosing and purchasing chickens Helps you construct the right housing for your chickens Provides tips on feeding and caring for your chickens Includes top tips for raising healthy chickens Whether you're a first-time poulterer or you've been raising chickens for years, this comprehensive guide provides practical how-to advice for keeping chickens in virtually any backyard.

Raising Chickens For Dummies (9781119675921) was previously published as Raising Chickens For Dummies (9781118982785). While this version features a new Dummies cover and design, the content is the same as the prior release and should not be considered a new or updated product.

hamradiofordummies4thedition.description_text:
Your how-to guide to become a ham

Amateur radio has been a popular pastime for years, and its popularity continues to grow. Ham Radio For Dummies is your guide to everything there is to know about ham radio. This updated edition provides new and additional information on digital mode operating, as well as use of amateur radio in student science and new operating events. If you're looking to join a college radio club or just want to learn the latest tips and tricks, this book is a helpful reference guide to beginners, or those who have been "hams" for years.

Inside:

  • Successfully set up your radio
  • Communicate with people around the world
  • Prepare for and pass the licensing exam
  • Provide communication during an emergency

two-wayradiosandscannersfordummies.human_name: Two-Way Radios and Scanners For Dummies
two-wayradiosandscannersfordummies.description_text:
The book is a survey of all the radio options for the individual, such as short-wave listening, all the different unlicensed radio services (those neat handheld radios you can buy everywhere, for example), Citizens Band and Amateur Radio, marine HF and VHF communications for sailors, aviation radio, public safety, TV-FM-AM DXing, and using a scanner to listen to public safety or at sporting events (air shows, auto races), weather information and other broadcast signals. Each topic includes definitions, operating conventions, equipment availability, licensing (if required), and any special technical information.

Also includes instruction on how to use antennas and the electronics and installation required for good results in the home, car, and portably.

photovoltaicdesignandinstallationfordumm.description_text: Photovoltaic Design & Installation For Dummies contains the basic knowledge necessary to understand the operation of solar-panel systems, including information on the electrical and mathematical concepts that are necessary to understand solar-panel systems. In addition, Readers can use this book to help study for the NABCEP exam and as a resource for courses on photovoltaics.

alternativeenergyfordummies.description_text: Alternative Energy For Dummies presents readers with a multifaceted examination of various forms of alternative energy, including solar, wind, nuclear, biomass, geothermal, biofuel, and other sources. Each alternative scenario is compared to current fossil-fuel intensive practices in the scientific, environmental, social, political, and economic realms.

canningandpreservingfordummies3rdedition.description_text:
Craving a peach in the middle of winter? Or, want tomato soup before the seeds are in the ground? Be in control of your food supply year round with Canning & Preserving For Dummies, 3rd Edition. This long-time top seller from the For Dummies family will keep your kitchen versatile long after harvest. Included among the topics are easy-to-follow guides for freezing, canning, preserving, pickling, dehydrating, juicing, and root cellaring.

Updates include:

  • Additional reasons for preserving food, including food shortages and how to make use of the food that is available
  • Expanded section on food storage spaces in urban living
  • Updated safety guidelines (reusable lids & Star San as a sanitizer)
  • Easy-to-follow charts 10 new recipes

solarpoweryourhomefordummies2ndedition.human_name: Solar Power Your Home For Dummies, 2nd Edition
solarpoweryourhomefordummies2ndedition.description_text: Solar Power Your Home For Dummies is the bestselling consumer guide to solar power in North America. Updates for the second edition ensure that this title continues to provide readers with accurate and timely information on a subject that is constantly evolving. Solar Power Your Home For Dummies, 2nd Edition, includes updates on changes to federal, state, and local regulations, laws, and tax incentives that seek to make solar-power adoption more feasible. Expanded coverage of the technology that underpins full-scale solar-power systems for the home have been added in direct response to consumer demand. With this information, readers are better positioned to weigh the pros and cons of embarking on what can be an expensive undertaking. New small and mid-sized solar products, projects, and applications are discussed, along with updated pricing information for the same.

hobbyfarmingfordummies.description_text: Hobby Farming For Dummies is a strategic addition to our sustainable/green publishing initiative, as it introduces a back-to-basics and self-sufficient segment that appeals to many readers interested in green living. The addition of a foundational title for this back-to-basics segment will allow us to align a number of existing titles, such as Canning and Preserving For Dummies and Beekeeping For Dummies (40,000+ net unit shipped, each, RTD) more closely with the overall sustainable/green initiative.

howtofixeverythingfordummies.human_name: How to Fix Everything For Dummies
howtofixeverythingfordummies.description_text: This hands-on, informative Do-it-Yourself (DIY) manual shows readers not only how to fix faulty appliances but also tend to all those irritating repairs that cost more to have someone else fix than the item is worth. Featuring clear, concise directions, How to Fix Everything For Dummies will explain how to fix furniture (like wobby chair or table legs and fixing nicks, etc), vacuum cleaners, refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, garbage disposals, toasters, blenders, radios, televisions, and even computers and printer glitches. How to Fix Everything For Dummies will also cover using the proper tools and materials to get the job done correctly without breaking the bank.  It's an excellent reference guide to have in the home for fixing everyone's stuff.

developers.developer-name: Gary Hedstrom, Peg Hedstrom, Judy Ondrla Tremore

homemaintenancefordummies3rdedition.description_text:
THE SINK IS MAKING THAT NOISE AGAIN.

Stop putting Band-Aids on every problem and save thousands in repair costs with Home Maintenance For Dummies, 3rd Edition. This comprehensive update will make it possible for any first-time homeowner or DIY rookie to keep up with basic home repairs in any room of the house. Learn how to conduct routine inspections, keep major appliances running efficiently, and avoid costly mistakes. Make a list for the must-have tools in your toolbox. Find how to determine when its time for maintenance and recognize the difference between an easy DIY repair and something an expert should handle. With Dummies hands on, step-by-step guides, detailed diagrams, and instructions for every room of the home, youll finally be able to stop that leaky faucet or calm that roaring fan.

UPDATES INCLUDE: 

  • Heating and cooling systems
  • Tankless water heaters
  • LED lighting Solar power 
  • Guide to a basic home repair tool kit

electronicsfordummies3rdedition.description_text:
Explore the basic concepts of electronics, build your electronics workbench, and begin creating fun electronics projects right away! Circuit basics: learn what voltage is, where current flows (and doesnt flow), and how power is used in a circuit. Critical components: discover how resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, and transistors control and shape electric current. Versatile chips: find out how to use analog and digital integrated circuits to build complex projects with just a few parts. Analyze circuits: understand the rules that govern current and voltage and learn how to apply them. Safety tips: get a thorough grounding in how to protect yourself--and your electronics--from harm. Electronics For Dummies, 3rd Edition covers the latest advancements in circuitry, transmitters, hardware, robotics, microcontrollers, tools and amplifiers. It will be full color, and several new projects and breadboard projects are being developed for the book.

The content covers:

  • Very brief overview of the science of electronics
  • Required tools and safety
  • Learning all about the multimeter
  • Other test tools of the trade (oscilloscope, logic probe, etc.)
  • Common electronic components (e.g. resistors, capacitors, transistors)
  • Making circuits using breadboards and printed circuit boards
  • Microcontrollers (implementation and programming)
  • Practical circuits to try (10 minutes or less)

gardeningbasicsfordummies2ndedition.description_text:
Create the garden of your dreams with the right plants and equipment Gardening Basics For Dummies 2e gives gardeners tips, plans, and insider know-how for getting started with flower beds, borders, vegetables, trees, shrubs, lawns, and more. Packed with advice, resources, illustrations, and plant recommendations, this friendly guide covers all the tools that make gardening today easier than ever before!

Updates include:

  • New section on bienniels
  • New section on summer flowering bulbs
  • New chapter, Multiplying Your Plants, provides more information on seed starting and other ways of multiplying plants
  • Completely updated appendix detailing resources

backyardhomesteadingall-in-onefordummies.description_text:
Backyard Homesteading AIO For Dummies has a little bit of everything. It walks you through the basics of creating your own sustainable homestead.

Topics include:

  • Raising and keeping chickens
  • Beekeeping
  • Composting Canning & preserving
  • Sustainable landscaping
  • Organic gardening

breadmakingfordummies.description_text:
Craving fresh baked bread? Bread Making For Dummies has got you covered! With more than 65 mouth-watering recipes, you'll find so much more about how to make consistently delicious breads, from classic yeast breads to sourdough. to pretzels and sweet treats. Perhaps you've never cultured your own yeast and desire the freedom to add fermented breads to your weekly menu. 

Bread Making For Dummies will also cover no-knead and sourdough recipes that have become popular over the past decade. Get your butter knives ready, and discover how easy bread baking can be!

vanlifefordummies.description_text:
When I LIVE IN A VAN DOWN BY THE RIVER sounds like a great option!

The lure of the open road is hard to resist. Who doesn't love the notion of days spent in placid woods and evenings watching the sunset. But, it's difficult to consistently experience those moments other than one the few days a year you have for vacation. Van life changes that paradigm. Van lifers enjoy a life untethered to an address, taking careers on the road in a simplified way of living. This book demystifies how to step into van life, from preparing to make the switch to customizing a vehicle to making it all work in the locations of your choosing.

Inside...

  • Evaluating if van life if for you
  • Deciding to go part- or full-time
  • Customizing a vehicle to your needs
  • Exploring how to take your career on the road with you
  • Answering the big question "Where do I use the bathroom?"
  • Living the off-grid life
  • Getting tips from experienced van lifers

windpowerfordummies.description_text: Wind Power For Dummies guides readers through each step of the process in acquiring, installing, and maintaining a home-scale wind turbine system. Coverage includes conducting a home energy audit to assess current energy use; determining if wind power is right for their home; explanations of the mechanics of wind power at home; how to tie into the grid and sell energy back to the power company; how to finance the project; and how to work with contractors.

cast-ironcookingfordummies2ndedition.description_text:
Cast iron for the modern age!

Despite being popular for thousands of years, cast-iron has much to offer modern-day cooks; it's easy to use, easy to care for, economical, versatile, and durable. Most cast-iron cooks will tell you that food cooked in cast-iron tastes better than food cooked using other methods! Cast-Iron Cooking For Dummies, Second Edition will teach you all you need to know about making great food using cast-iron, and provides you with dozens of recipes for the best dishes suited for cast-iron. You will learn how to select the right cast-iron cookware for you; how to season and care for your cast-iron cookware; and how to make your cast-iron cookware last longer.

Updates to this edition include:

  • New color insert - with photos of cast-iron cookware and meals
  • A guide to all of the new cast-iron cookware companies - what to look for/be aware of
  • New section covering food styling and catering using cast-iron cookware, and current trends in the food service industry, and how this can elevate your next party or event.
  • New recipes for cooking with meat - will no longer just focus on American classics, but will include meat dishes that represent different cultures and more modern/popular recipes.
  • Stronger focus on explaining cast iron's versatility and how it allows cooks to maximize different cooking techniques.
  • Updated fish recipes that reflect popular fish used in restaurants and focusing on different cooking techniques that can be used to produce the dish.
  • The veggie chapter focuses on seasonal vegetables and the benefits of using in-season products. Recipes are simple and teach the reader how to enhance the flavors
  • Totally updated chapter with global recipes that reflect a multitude of cultures.

covenanthouse.description_text:
Donations to support Covenant House are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

Covenant House is the nation's largest movement providing food, shelter, immediate crisis care, and ongoing services to homeless and trafficked young people. Founded in 1972 in New York, Covenant House has grown to serve over 46,000 youth annually in 30 cities across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. At Covenant House, we offer basic necessities to any homeless young person who knocks on our door—with unconditional love—no questions asked and no strings attached. Once a young person is staying with us, our programs provide the structure they need to get off the street, plan for the future, and achieve independence. Our full continuum of services include: 

  • Food
  • Shelter
  • Healthcare
  • Legal Services
  • Educational Services
  • Employment TrainingMental Health Counseling
  • Mother and Children Services
  • Long-term and Permanent Housing

Make-A-Wish® creates life-changing wishes for children with critical illnesses. We seek to bring every eligible child's wish to life because a wish is an integral part of a child's treatment journey. Research shows children who have wishes granted can build the physical and emotional strength they need to fight their illness. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, Make-A-Wish is the world’s leading children’s wish-granting organization, serving children in more than 50 countries worldwide. Together, generous donors, supporters, staff and more than 40,000 volunteers, grant a wish every 17 minutes, on average, somewhere in the world. Since 1980, Make-A-Wish has granted nearly 450,000 wishes to children; more than 30,000 last year alone. For more information about Make-A-Wish International, visit worldwish.org and for more information about Make-A-Wish America, visit wish.org.
